lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs are arranged in approximately 5-6 visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The spacing is semi-regular, forming a grid-like pattern across the mid-to-lower flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to create a series of high-contrast nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the upper edge and a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A small commensal fish (remora) is visible in the lower-left quadrant, oriented horizontally near the base of the fourth and fifth gill slits.
